svg.title: UC-15 · Ranking through Thera / Turnur (EVE-Scout wormholes)

g.text: UC-15 · Ranking through Thera / Turnur (EVE-Scout wormholes)
choose Gates only / Thera / Turnur (radio buttons, kept in the evedm_prefs cookie)
signatures (hub, in_system, remaining_hours, type, max_ship_size, in_signature, out_signature)
GET ...?system_name=<hub> only for a configured hub missing from the answer
keep Thera / Turnur rows, drop J-space and unknown systems (End Of Life rows are kept),
one row per system, order by security (high first), then name
keep the last list, remember the error (shown under the filter)
bfs(target) : direct gate routes of the characters
[the chosen hub (thera=1: every hub) with a list]
multi_bfs(listed systems, avoid) (cached per hub and list version)
nearest listed system + gate path for the character and for the target
entry = closest listed system to the character (higher security wins a tie)
exit = closest listed system to the target (same rule)
jumps = gates to entry + 2 (wormhole in and out) + gates from exit
entry = exit: the plain gate route is shorter, hub skipped
fewest jumps over the chosen hubs; used only when STRICTLY shorter than the direct gate route
rows with jumps, route, route_legs [gate, wormhole, gate], wormhole{hub, entry, exit, direct_jumps, used,
in / out signature and size of entry and exit, min_size}
"via Thera" badge, note in the route bar, dashed purple wormhole leg between two gold gate legs on the map;
route bar: InSig / OutSig beside entry and exit, ship-size icon (smaller of the two) in the hub hop
